A page for shared notes.

### 🚀 Features
- **Shared with me** page.
- Note files get readable names on disk.
- One-view links keep working after they're opened.
- To-do cards get quick actions.

### 🐛 Fixes
- Uses the system text cursor instead of a drawn one.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.1.19...v0.1.20](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.1.19...v0.1.20)
